name: Narada
description: Send your saved Narada and Postman collection requests from Orca's sidebar: pick a request and an environment, edit its params, headers and body, read the response, or save a new request from cURL.

screenshots.alt: The Narada panel with List orders chosen in the Local environment, status=open and limit=3 as params, and a 200 OK response listing three orders
screenshots.caption: Send a saved request and read the response

screenshots.alt: The Narada panel with the Production environment, a prompt for one secret variable, and the Shop API collection open at Create order
screenshots.caption: Your Narada collections, folders and environments
